# freezer-temperature-input

validTemperature(value) returns a boolean. Accept exactly finite primitive JavaScript numbers, including negative and fractional readings and zero. Reject NaN, both infinities, numeric strings, boxed numbers, null, undefined and booleans. There is no temperature range limit.

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`. Preserve the public API and existing tests. Use only Node built-ins; no dependencies or network access.
